latest_post.summary: 第一三共とメルクが共同開発中の肺がん治療薬について、米国での迅速承認申請を取り下げたと事実を報じた。
latest_post.summary_en: It reported the fact that Daiichi Sankyo and Merck withdrew their application for accelerated approval in the United States for a lung cancer therapeutic drug currently under joint development.
